heraliz_emote.borrow.success: Borrowed %s's emote: stand up to play it
heraliz_emote.config.title: Heraliz Emote
heraliz_emote.config.subtitle: Look at a dancing player and press Shift + right click to dance with them
heraliz_emote.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns borrowing on or off. The keys stay bound but do nothing when off.
heraliz_emote.config.empty_hand_only.too: Borrow only when your main hand is empty, so the click still uses the item you hold.
heraliz_emote.config.sync_emote.tooltip: Looping emotes start at the same moment as the other player's. Others always start from the beginning.
heraliz_emote.config.borrow_sound.toolti: Borrowed emotes keep their music. Hold the Reverse sound key to flip this for one borrow.
heraliz_emote.config.show_messages.toolt: Show a message above the hotbar when you borrow an emote.
heraliz_emote.config.hold_seconds.toolti: How long a borrowed emote waits for you to stop crouching before it is dropped.
heraliz_emote.config.reach.tooltip: How far away the player you borrow from can be.
heraliz_emote.config.hide_emotecraft_emo: Leaves out the emotes that come with Emotecraft (waving, clap, backflip...). Takes effect after restarting the game.
heraliz_emote.menu.title: Emotes
heraliz_emote.menu.hint: Double click or Enter: play  ·  Drag the preview: turn  ·  Esc: close
heraliz_emote.menu.cannot: Not now: stand still on your feet
heraliz_emote.config.other_players.toolt: Hear the music and sound effects of the emotes other players play. Off: you only hear your own.
heraliz_emote.refused.combat: No emotes while in combat (%s s left)
heraliz_emote.menu.subtitle: %s emotes · %s with props
heraliz_emote.menu.on: On: you hear other players' emotes
heraliz_emote.menu.off: Off: you only hear your own
heraliz_emote.refused.locked: Emote to unlock in the emote crate
heraliz_emote.no_weapon: No weapons after an emote (%s s left)
heraliz_emote.menu.locked_tip: To unlock in the emote crate
